definitions.explanation: To look at and comprehend written text. Used for books, newspapers, signs, emails, and any written material.
To speak written words out loud, as in reading poetry or reading to someone.
To anticipate or predict something, as in 'reading' a situation or someone's intentions. {空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む means to read the atmosphere/room.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}む (read X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {読|よ}んでいる = 'is reading.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}む (read a book)
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}む (read newspaper)
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}む (read the room - idiom)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧{読|よ}む (read aloud)

Godan verb: te-form {読|よ}んで. Cultural: ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}む refers to understanding social cues. KY = ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧{読|よ}めない (can't read the room).
